title: Towards Global Counterfactual-Based Self-Explainable Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.29681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Counterfactual Explanations (GCEs) have emerged as an effective approach for interpreting Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictions by identifying minimal graph modifications needed to change predictions. However, existing methods suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) They rely on a post-hoc explanation paradigm, where a separate explainer is trained after the GNN. This sequential optimization prevents the explainer from leveraging how the GNN learned its representations, often resulting in lower-quality explanations. (2) They are largely local, generating counterfactual explanations only for individual samples. Consequently, they fail to capture generalizable patterns across the data distribution, a crucial gap for applications like drug discovery, where global principles enable systematic decision-making across thousands of cases. translated_title: 迈向基于全局反事实的自解释图神经网络
translated_abstract: 图反事实解释（GCEs）已成为解释图神经网络（GNN）预测的一种有效方法，它通过识别改变预测所需的最小图修改来实现解释。然而，现有方法存在两个根本性局限：（1）它们依赖事后解释范式，即在GNN训练完成后再训练一个单独的解释器。这种顺序优化使解释器无法利用GNN学习其表示的方式，往往导致解释质量较低。（2）它们在很大程度上是局部性的，仅为单个样本生成反事实解释，因此无法捕获数据分布中可泛化的模式，这对药物发现等应用而言是一个关键缺口，因为在这些应用中，全局原则能够支持对数千个案例进行系统性决策。为解决这些局限，我们提出了GCSGNN（基于全局反事实的自解释图神经网络）。
tldr: 提出GCSGNN，一种将全局反事实解释融入模型自身的自解释图神经网络，克服了现有方法事后解释和仅能局部解释的两大局限。
en_tdlr: GCSGNN is a self-explainable GNN that incorporates global counterfactual explanations, overcoming the limitations of post-hoc and local-only explanation paradigms.
